key_insight: Infinity-Wasserstein robust PCA admits an exact finite-dimensional reformulation while retaining samplewise residual information that can reshape the learned principal subspace.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a distributionally robust approach to dimensionality reduction and representation learning when the deployment distribution may differ from the empirical data.
method: Reformulate infinity-Wasserstein robust PCA exactly and explicitly construct a worst-case distribution.
Establish a uniform finite-sample performance guarantee assuming a finite fourth moment.
Solve the nonconvex, nonsmooth problem with iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization and analyze convergence.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments support computational efficiency and downstream effectiveness, but the abstract reports no datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains.
watch_item: The reformulated problem remains nonconvex, so the reported convergence analysis should not be read as a guarantee of global optimality.
paper_title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
